hero.description: I am an Application Engineer and Engineering Manager based in Japan, specializing in frontend development with a focus on React, Flutter, and DevOps.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am YUMA Kitamura, an Application Engineer, Engineering Manager with over 10 years of experience in building modern web applications. I am passionate about creating clean, efficient, and user-friendly interfaces.
about.p2: Currently, I lead a development team as an Engineering Manager at wevnal, inc., focusing on creating innovative solutions for clients. While my core strength lies in frontend development with React, Vue, and TypeScript, I actively stay up to date with new technologies and frameworks.
about.p3: Outside of development, I enjoy contributing to open source, writing technical articles, and sharing knowledge within the community. I also actively lead the organization of tech conferences such as FlutterKaigi and Frontend Conference Kansai.
